held_list.headline: Because of AI, 52% of students with elevated depressive symptoms who used a generative-AI coaching app for six weeks improved meaningfully, against 32% given care as usual.
Because of AI, the Hurricane Center called a Category 5 landfall in Jamaica about three days out, while Melissa was still a Category 1.
Because of AI, Oman screened 43,000 diabetics for retinopathy, flagged 12,000 for treatment, and cut specialist waiting lists by 87%.

Because of AI, specialist consultations at two hospitals in western China took 3.14 minutes instead of 4.41 when patients first gave their history to a chatbot, and patients rated communication easier.
held_list.detail: evidence: drafter A, verifier could not grade.

leads_added: AI feedback for clinician assessment of umbilical and middle cerebral artery Doppler ultrasound: a multicenter randomized trial. [AJOG MFM](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajogmf.2026.102192) (2026-11-06). Randomized, but likely clinician performance rather than patient outcomes; `npm run read` returns NOT READ (11 characters). Missing: full text, whether patients were reached, absolute effects.

Protocols to watch: usage feedback, reminders and generative-AI use at work in a Chinese export firm, [AEARCTR-0019968](https://www.socialscienceregistry.org/trials/19968) (2026-10-26 to 2027-10-31); AI-assisted tutoring in rural China, [AEARCTR-0020058](https://www.socialscienceregistry.org/trials/20058) (2027-01-15 to 2028-04-30).
Still open from 2026-11-06: Rosie chatbot maternal-health null (JAMA Netw Open) and AEARCTR-0019001; no readable primary source or results yet.

Skipped: EdArXiv and PsyArXiv survey-style experiments, protocols, systematic reviews, ERIC items already seen, medRxiv retrospective models and simulations, and a feasibility study of AI-enhanced VR CBT.
